description: Shared CN autoscaling and Wakhan calibration for two chromosome-local haplotypes.
name: copy-number

params.name: singleCopyDepth
params.description: Expected read-depth increase per additional inferred copy, from the selected Wakhan solution's run log.

params.name: depthOffset
params.description: Read-depth intercept at zero inferred copies, from the archived Plotly CN-axis calibration: depth = singleCopyDepth * copies + depthOffset.
